chunks: From him, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Basir, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام: concerning
A man who came to a beast and penetrated it—he said: “The hadd punishment is upon him.”

key_terms.بَهِيمَةً: a beast or animal; the object involved in the prohibited act
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.فَأَوْلَجَ: then penetrated; indicating completion of the sexual act
key_terms.ٱلْحَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a man who has intercourse with an animal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who commits intercourse with an animal. Imam Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام states that the hadd punishment applies to him, showing the gravity of the act in Islamic jurisprudence.
